label: Beginner · Lesson 17
title: In, on, under
intro: Where is it? Today’s words and grammar, and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Qayerda? Bugungi so’zlar, grammatika va oldingi mavzular.
message: Beginner · Lesson 17 · In, on, under. Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: In, on, under or next to?
parts.uz: Uzbek so’zga qarang va to’g’risini aylantiring
items: The ball is {under|next to} the bed. (tagida)

parts.title: Write is or are
items: The TV ___ next to the window.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: is / the cat / the bed / under
the bag / is / in / my phone

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: There {is|are} three rooms in my home.
Madina is my sister. {His|Her} bag is red.

items.prompt: Write 4 sentences: where are the things in your room?
items.hint: Example: My bed is next to the window. My books are on the shelf.
